g.text: Fine-grained credit from trajectories already collected
One signal for the whole episode
Compare actions at the same state
A successful detour still gets rewarded.
Rank observed actions by future return.
Avoid fresh rollouts at every state
Naive: branch again at each step
Match across episodes AND time steps.
Keep the global goal; refine local choices
Coherent episodes + better decisions at recurring states
State matching matters: singleton groups add no local contrast.
Critic-free; fine-grained feedback depends on recurring states.
